This is because you're sending a signal to yourself and others that you're capable and competent. 3. **Physical appearance**: Research has shown that people who dress well tend to feel more attractive and confident. When you look good, you're more likely to feel good about yourself, which can boost your confidence and self-esteem. 4. **Self-perception theory**: This theory suggests that people's self-perceptions are influenced by their behavior and appearance. When you dress professionally, you may start to see yourself as more confident and capable, which can create a self-fulfilling prophecy. Overall, it's great that you've found a way to boost your confidence through dressing professionally!
